SEXNATURAL: MILFs Must Be Filled

Ghosts are real. Secrets are dangerous. And Gia and Aaron have a very… unconventional way of dealing with both.

SEXNATURAL: MILFs Must Be Filled is an adult-only visual novel blending paranormal investigation, horror, puzzles, hypnosis, and steamy encounters. Explore haunted locations, uncover disturbing secrets, dive into hidden memories, and get closer to the people caught in the middle of the supernatural chaos.

Meet Gia and Aaron — a fearless paranormal investigation.
Their job is simple: find the truth, deal with whatever is lurking in the shadows, and help those affected by it.
The problem? The people they meet often have just as many secrets as the ghosts they’re investigating.

Their newest case takes them to a seemingly ordinary family home with a very unusual problem: something is haunting the place.
As Gia and Aaron start digging, the case quickly turns into something much bigger.
And the closer they get to the truth, the harder it becomes to tell where the investigation ends… and temptation begins.

Key Features:

• Paranormal Investigation: Explore mysterious locations, inspect your surroundings, discover hidden clues, and piece together the truth behind each supernatural case.
• Puzzles & Mini-Games: Search for important items, reconstruct evidence, solve puzzles, and put your detective skills to the test.
• Retro ’80s Atmosphere: Step into a stylish world filled with vintage interiors, eerie locations, strange encounters, and secrets hiding around every corner.
• Mystery, Horror & Temptation: Follow the clues, uncover what’s really happening, and get dangerously close to the people involved. Sometimes the truth is scary. Sometimes it’s incredibly tempting. Are you ready to investigate the supernatural?

The ghosts are waiting. The secrets are buried. And the MILFs definitely need some attention.
